verdict.rationale: Pipecat Cloud's own REST API has two credential tiers. A public API key is limited to the /v1/public surface (starting agent sessions and proxying requests to them). Agent, secret, build and organization management sits on the separate private API. That is a coarse, built-in least-privilege split, but the pack does not document custom scopes, per-agent credentials, or how keys are issued. missing for 10: user-definable fine-grained scopes, per-agent or expiring credential issuance, documented key-management workflow, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: The public API (/v1/public, authenticated with a public API key) starts agent sessions and proxies requests to them. The private API (/v1...) manages agents, secrets, builds, regions, and organization settings.
